children: Intel (INTC) guides Q3 revenue $15.8B–$16.8B and adjusted EPS $0.38, after Q2 GAAP loss per share $2.16 and adjusted EPS $0.42.

Intel (INTC) shifts wafer capacity from PC chips to servers to meet AI demand. Hyperscaler capex boosts data-center demand; power and infrastructure limits may constrain capacity expansion.
